en.title: Claude Code Video Skills: The 2026 List
en.description: Agent skills that make video with Claude Code or Codex: HyperFrames, Remotion, Motionboard, brag and more, with install commands, licences and installs.
en.h1: Claude Code Video Skills: The 2026 List
en.lede: Claude Code video skills are agent skills that write a video as code and render it to MP4. As of 16 November 2026 the main options are HeyGen's HyperFrames skills, Remotion's official skill, Motionboard, and three third-party sets (brag, motion-graphics-skills and motion-graphics), all installed with `npx skills add`.

blocks.text: Install counts come from skills.sh and stars from GitHub, both read on 16 November 2026. skills.sh counts installs per skill, so a repository with several skills shows several numbers.

blocks.text: [HyperFrames](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes) is HeyGen's open-source framework that renders HTML, CSS and seekable animation to MP4. The repository has 84.6k GitHub stars and an Apache-2.0 licence, and it needs Node.js 22 or later and FFmpeg. skills.sh lists 54 skills for the repository. Four of them make video:

items: `hyperframes` (1.5M installs): builds videos from HTML and GSAP timelines, with captions, narration, text effects and scene transitions. It is the entry point for the other HyperFrames skills.

`product-launch-video` (539.5K): guides the agent through capturing a product, reading its brand, planning a launch video and building it frame by frame. It writes `STORYBOARD.md`, `SCRIPT.md` and one HTML file per frame into `videos/<project>/` and renders `renders/video.mp4`.
`general-video` (661.9K): the workflow for a custom composition when no specialised workflow fits, including longer and multi-scene pieces.
`motion-graphics` (514.5K): short, design-led pieces without narration, typically under about 10 seconds.

blocks.text: `npx skills add heygen-com/hyperframes` opens a picker, and `--all` installs every published skill. Claude Code users can also add the repository as a plugin marketplace with `claude plugin marketplace add heygen-com/hyperframes`. The comparison with Remotion is in [HyperFrames vs Remotion](/guides/hyperframes-vs-remotion/).

[Remotion](https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion) makes videos from React code and has 73.4k GitHub stars. Its team maintains [remotion-dev/skills](https://github.com/remotion-dev/skills) (7.2k stars), and the Remotion docs name Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Kimi Code and OpenCode as supported agents. The README lists 13 skills, among them `remotion-best-practices` (827.9K installs, over 30 rule files), `remotion-create`, `remotion-render`, `remotion-captions` and `remotion-license`.

Inside an existing Remotion project, `npx remotion skills add` installs the same set. The skills repository page states no licence. Remotion itself is free for individuals, for-profit organisations with up to 3 employees and non-profits, and every other organisation needs a company licence, according to Remotion's LICENSE.md. The `remotion-license` skill answers licence questions.

[Motionboard](https://github.com/krisyangdev/motionboard) is a free, MIT-licensed skill with 58 shot recipes taken from launch films by Apple, Linear and others. Each recipe is a film of about 10 seconds at 1920x1080, built with HyperFrames and shown next to the original clip. The skill plans a whole launch film from 4 to 6 recipes or builds a single shot, and it can port a shot to a website. The repository has 63 stars. skills.sh shows 13 installs for `motionboard` and 27 for the earlier name `motion-lexicon`. The step-by-step guide is [How to make a product launch video with Claude Code](/guides/product-launch-video-with-claude-code/).

[latent-spaces/brag](https://github.com/latent-spaces/brag) has 21.6k stars and an MIT licence. Its `/brag` skill turns the project you just built into a short launch video with music, motion and share copy in one command. It plans the story, hands a brief to HyperFrames and writes a `brag-output/` folder with the plan, the composition brief, the share copy and `brag.mp4`. Voiceover is off by default and `--voice` turns it on. `brag-slim` is a leaner variant for Claude Opus 5.5. Requirements are Node.js 22 or later and FFmpeg.

In Claude Code the repository also installs as a plugin with `/plugin marketplace add latent-spaces/brag` followed by `/plugin install brag@brag`. skills.sh lists `brag` at 24.4K installs and `brag-slim` at 13.9K.

[charlie947/motion-graphics-skills](https://github.com/charlie947/motion-graphics-skills) (684 stars, MIT) is a set of 15 skills in its README, for Claude Code and Codex. They cover setup (`brand-intake`), planning, launch videos (`launch-video`, `apple-launch-film`), explainers, animated charts and reels. Every skill reads a `brand.md` and a `MOTION.md` that `brand-intake` creates. Animations are HTML driven by `window.seek()`, and the MP4 export uses HyperFrames (optional) or ffmpeg with Chrome. skills.sh lists 46.2K installs across the 15 skills, about 3K each.

[Barty-Bart/motion-graphics](https://github.com/Barty-Bart/motion-graphics) (1.3k stars, MIT) has six skills for Claude Code, with Codex also named in its description: `motion-broll` (B-roll timed to a transcript), `object-separation`, `explainer-high-energy` (a 12 to 20 second promo with beat-locked kinetic type), `explainer-default` (a 45 to 90 second product demo), `explainer-engaging` (a 10 to 30 second one-take story) and `sound-effects`. skills.sh lists 17.7K installs across the six.
Claude Motion, the option without a skill

Anthropic announced Claude Motion on 8 October 2026 as a beta for Team and Enterprise plans. It is on by default for Team and off by default for Enterprise until an owner enables it under Organization settings > Artifacts. Claude builds each animation from the Motion template as code that animates text, charts, shapes and images, and Anthropic states that no video generation model is involved. The result exports as MP4. Longer or more complex animations use more of the plan's usage limit. The skills above write project files into your own folder, which you can edit and render again. [Can Claude make videos?](/guides/can-claude-make-videos/) compares the two routes.

items: Open a terminal in your project folder.
Run `npx skills add <owner>/<repo>`, for example `npx skills add krisyangdev/motionboard`. Add `--skill <name>` to install one skill from a repository, or `--list` to see what it contains.
Add `-g` to install at user level, so every project can use the skill. Without it the skill is installed for the current project only. `-y` skips the confirmation prompts.
Start Claude Code or Codex and describe the video you want. The agent loads the skill when the request matches its description.
A complete launch video from your own repository in one command: `brag`, or `product-launch-video` for a longer, step-by-step process with a storyboard and script.
One specific shot, such as a match cut, a zoom to the cursor or a logo reveal, or a launch film assembled from named shots: Motionboard.
A video inside an existing React codebase: the Remotion skills. Check the company licence rule first if your organisation has more than 3 employees.
A short branded motion piece, chart or reel: `motion-graphics` from HeyGen, or `motion-graphics-skills` for a larger set with a shared brand file.
A promo, product demo or B-roll with sound effects: the Barty-Bart set.
No terminal and a Team or Enterprise plan: Claude Motion.
Which Claude Code skill makes a product launch video?

HeyGen's `product-launch-video` (539.5K installs), `brag` (24.4K), Motionboard (58 shot recipes) and `launch-video` in charlie947/motion-graphics-skills all target launch videos. The first two build a whole film from a product; Motionboard works from named shots.
Do these skills work in Codex?

The Remotion docs name Codex as a supported agent, charlie947/motion-graphics-skills documents a Codex install path, and Barty-Bart's description names Codex. Motionboard installs into Claude Code and Codex with the same command. All of them install with `npx skills add`.
Are the video skills free?

The repositories in this list are free to install. The licences are Apache-2.0 for HyperFrames and MIT for Motionboard, brag, motion-graphics-skills and Barty-Bart/motion-graphics. Remotion uses its own licence, which requires a company licence from for-profit organisations with more than 3 employees.
What do I need installed?
HyperFrames needs Node.js 22 or later and FFmpeg, and the skills built on it (Motionboard, brag) list the same requirements. Remotion projects run on Node.js with the Remotion packages.

zh.description: Claude Code 视频 skills 清单：HyperFrames、Remotion、Motionboard、brag，含安装命令和许可证。
zh.h1: Claude Code 视频 Skills 清单（2026）
zh.lede: Claude Code 视频 skill 是让 agent 把视频写成代码并渲染成 MP4 的技能包。截至 2026 年 11 月 16 日，主要选择有 HeyGen 的 HyperFrames skills、Remotion 官方 skill、Motionboard，以及三套第三方技能（brag、motion-graphics-skills、motion-graphics），都用 `npx skills add` 安装。

blocks.text: 安装量来自 skills.sh，星标来自 GitHub，均为 2026 年 11 月 16 日读取。skills.sh 按单个 skill 统计安装量，一个仓库包含多个 skill 时会显示多个数字。

blocks.text: [HyperFrames](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes) 是 HeyGen 的开源框架，把 HTML、CSS 和可定位的动画渲染成 MP4。仓库有 84.6k 个 GitHub 星标，许可证为 Apache-2.0，需要 Node.js 22 或更高版本和 FFmpeg。skills.sh 为这个仓库列出 54 个 skill，其中四个用来做视频：

items: `hyperframes`（1.5M 次安装）：用 HTML 和 GSAP 时间线做视频，支持字幕、旁白、文字效果和转场。它是其他 HyperFrames skills 的入口。
`product-launch-video`（539.5K）：带 agent 完成采集产品、读取品牌、规划发布视频、逐帧搭建。它把 `STORYBOARD.md`、`SCRIPT.md` 和每一帧的 HTML 文件写入 `videos/<project>/`，并渲染出 `renders/video.mp4`。
`general-video`（661.9K）：没有合适的专用流程时，用来搭建自定义合成，包括较长和多场景的作品。
`motion-graphics`（514.5K）：以设计为主、无旁白的短片，通常在约 10 秒以内。

blocks.text: `npx skills add heygen-com/hyperframes` 会打开选择器，`--all` 安装全部已发布的 skill。Claude Code 用户也可以用 `claude plugin marketplace add heygen-com/hyperframes` 把仓库加成插件市场。与 Remotion 的对比见 [HyperFrames 与 Remotion 对比](/guides/hyperframes-vs-remotion/)。

[Remotion](https://github.com/remotion-dev/remotion) 用 React 代码做视频，有 73.4k 个 GitHub 星标。团队维护 [remotion-dev/skills](https://github.com/remotion-dev/skills)（7.2k 星标），Remotion 文档把 Claude Code、Codex、Cursor、Kimi Code 和 OpenCode 列为支持的 agent。README 列出 13 个 skill，包括 `remotion-best-practices`（827.9K 次安装，30 多个规则文件）、`remotion-create`、`remotion-render`、`remotion-captions` 和 `remotion-license`。
在已有的 Remotion 项目里，`npx remotion skills add` 会安装同一套。skills 仓库页面没有标明许可证。根据 Remotion 的 LICENSE.md，个人、最多 3 名员工的营利组织和非营利组织可以免费使用，其他组织需要公司许可证。`remotion-license` skill 可以回答许可证问题。

[Motionboard](https://github.com/krisyangdev/motionboard) 是免费的 MIT 许可 skill，包含 58 个镜头配方，取自 Apple、Linear 等公司的发布片。每个配方是一支约 10 秒、1920x1080 的短片，用 HyperFrames 制作，并与原片并排展示。这个 skill 能用 4 到 6 个配方规划整支发布片，也能单独做一个镜头，还能把镜头移植到网站。仓库有 63 个星标。skills.sh 显示 `motionboard` 有 13 次安装，旧名 `motion-lexicon` 有 27 次。分步教程见[用 Claude Code 制作产品发布视频](/guides/product-launch-video-with-claude-code/)。

[latent-spaces/brag](https://github.com/latent-spaces/brag) 有 21.6k 个星标，许可证为 MIT。它的 `/brag` skill 用一条命令把刚做完的项目做成带音乐、动效和分享文案的短发布视频。它先规划故事，再把 brief 交给 HyperFrames，输出 `brag-output/` 文件夹，里面有计划、合成 brief、分享文案和 `brag.mp4`。旁白默认关闭，加 `--voice` 开启。`brag-slim` 是面向 Claude Opus 5.5 的精简版。运行需要 Node.js 22 或更高版本和 FFmpeg。
在 Claude Code 里，也可以先执行 `/plugin marketplace add latent-spaces/brag`，再执行 `/plugin install brag@brag`，以插件方式安装。skills.sh 上 `brag` 有 24.4K 次安装，`brag-slim` 有 13.9K 次。

[charlie947/motion-graphics-skills](https://github.com/charlie947/motion-graphics-skills)（684 星标，MIT）的 README 列出 15 个 skill，面向 Claude Code 和 Codex。内容涵盖初始设置（`brand-intake`）、规划、发布视频（`launch-video`、`apple-launch-film`）、讲解视频、动画图表和 Reels。每个 skill 都会先读取 `brand-intake` 生成的 `brand.md` 和 `MOTION.md`。动画是由 `window.seek()` 驱动的 HTML，MP4 导出使用 HyperFrames（可选）或 ffmpeg 加 Chrome。skills.sh 显示 15 个 skill 合计 46.2K 次安装，每个约 3K。

[Barty-Bart/motion-graphics](https://github.com/Barty-Bart/motion-graphics)（1.3k 星标，MIT）有六个 skill，面向 Claude Code，描述里也提到 Codex：`motion-broll`（按字幕时间点生成 B-roll）、`object-separation`、`explainer-high-energy`（12 到 20 秒、节拍对齐的动态文字宣传片）、`explainer-default`（45 到 90 秒的产品演示）、`explainer-engaging`（10 到 30 秒的一镜到底故事）和 `sound-effects`。skills.sh 显示六个 skill 合计 17.7K 次安装。
Claude Motion：不用 skill 的选项

Anthropic 在 2026 年 10 月 8 日发布 Claude Motion，目前是面向 Team 和 Enterprise 套餐的测试版。Team 默认开启，Enterprise 默认关闭，需要组织所有者在 Organization settings > Artifacts 里启用。Claude 根据 Motion 模板把每段动画写成代码，让文字、图表、形状和图片动起来，Anthropic 说明过程中没有使用视频生成模型。结果可导出为 MP4。较长或较复杂的动画会消耗更多套餐用量。上面的 skills 会把项目文件写进你自己的文件夹，可以继续编辑并重新渲染。两条路线的对比见[Claude 能做视频吗](/guides/can-claude-make-videos/)。

items: 在项目文件夹里打开终端。
运行 `npx skills add <owner>/<repo>`，例如 `npx skills add krisyangdev/motionboard`。加 `--skill <name>` 只安装仓库里的某一个 skill，加 `--list` 查看仓库包含哪些 skill。
加 `-g` 安装到用户级别，所有项目都能使用；不加则只安装到当前项目。`-y` 跳过确认提示。
启动 Claude Code 或 Codex，描述想要的视频。请求与 skill 的描述匹配时，agent 会加载它。
用一条命令从自己的仓库生成完整发布视频：`brag`；需要分镜和脚本的分步流程，选 `product-launch-video`。
单个具体镜头，如 Match Cut、推近到光标或 logo 揭示，或者用指定镜头拼成发布片：Motionboard。
在已有的 React 代码库里做视频：Remotion skills。组织超过 3 名员工时，先确认公司许可证规则。
品牌化的短动态片段、图表或 Reels：HeyGen 的 `motion-graphics`，或带统一品牌文件、规模更大的 `motion-graphics-skills`。
带音效的宣传片、产品演示或 B-roll：Barty-Bart 这一套。
不想用终端，且使用 Team 或 Enterprise 套餐：Claude Motion。
哪个 Claude Code skill 能做产品发布视频？
HeyGen 的 `product-launch-video`（539.5K 次安装）、`brag`（24.4K）、Motionboard（58 个镜头配方）和 charlie947/motion-graphics-skills 里的 `launch-video` 都面向发布视频。前两个从产品出发做整支片子，Motionboard 从指定镜头出发。
这些 skill 能在 Codex 里用吗？
Remotion 文档把 Codex 列为支持的 agent，charlie947/motion-graphics-skills 写明了 Codex 的安装路径，Barty-Bart 的描述也提到 Codex。Motionboard 用同一条命令安装到 Claude Code 和 Codex。它们都通过 `npx skills add` 安装。
这些视频 skill 免费吗？
清单里的仓库都可以免费安装。HyperFrames 的许可证是 Apache-2.0，Motionboard、brag、motion-graphics-skills 和 Barty-Bart/motion-graphics 是 MIT。Remotion 使用自己的许可证，超过 3 名员工的营利组织需要公司许可证。
需要先装什么？
HyperFrames 需要 Node.js 22 或更高版本和 FFmpeg，基于它的 skill（Motionboard、brag）列出相同要求。Remotion 项目在 Node.js 上运行，并使用 Remotion 的软件包。
